what_changed: NCUA proposes removing its nondiscrimination regulation in 12 CFR 701 that summarized Fair Housing Act prohibitions for real-estate-related loans, appraisals and advertising; the Fair Housing Act continues to apply to federal credit unions.
rationale: The regulation removed concerns real-estate lending under the Fair Housing Act (mortgage-only), and the abstract states the statute keeps applying, so no consumer-loan servicing obligation changes. The keyword match was 'appraisal' in the housing sense, not an insurance appraisal clause. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
